steps.t: Read Annual Report 2025 p.34 and Presentation 2Q26 p.9-10. Write the spread in 3 sentences: coil in, pipe out, profit is the gap.
Who buys pipes: drillers (OCTG), pipeline and water projects (line pipe), construction, car makers. For each, what makes them spend? (rig count, budgets, rates, car output)
Crisis timeline: 2008, 2015 oil crash, 2018 Section 232 tariffs, 2020 COVID. One line each: what happened, why, what it did to pipe demand and margins. Add the source.
Benchmark: Borusan EBITDA margin 2021-25 (Guidance page) next to the US steel sector (Damodaran, Margins by Sector, Steel: EBITDA/sales 10.58%).
Ask 'so what?': in which years was Borusan above or below the sector, and why? Write 3 bullets for Borusan.
Each of us: one insight in Notes with document, page and date.

p11.title: 1.1 Steel sector: how it works and what crises do to it

steps.t: Presentation 2Q26 p.4: Borusan in 3 sentences. What it sells, where, how big (2025: 1.31m tons, $1.8bn revenue, 7.4% EBITDA margin).
Write the period next to every number. p.4 is full-year 2025; 1H26 revenue is $976.9m (p.21).
US share: 73% in 2025 (p.4), 79% in 1H26 (p.13). Is this concentration a risk? Write your view.
Capacity vs revenue: Türkiye 1.05m tons, US 0.95m tons (p.5), but most revenue is US. What does that say about Turkish plants? (Gemlik, p.17)
Backlog: about $2.6bn signed for 2026-2028 (p.4). Compare it with 2025 revenue of $1.8bn.
Latest news on KAP and the IR site: orders, credit rating, results calendar (Q3 results on Nov 6).

p12.title: 1.2 Borusan and the news: what it sells, where revenue comes from

steps.t: One table 2021-2025: volume, revenue, EBITDA, margin. Sources: Guidance page and the annual financial reports.
Why did margin fall from 18.2% (2023) to 6.0% (2024)? Split it into price, cost and volume using the 2024 Financial Report.
Unit economics each year: revenue per ton and EBITDA per ton (2025: about $1,374 and $102).
Debt: net financial debt $225m (2Q25), $178m (2025), $144m (2Q26), Presentation p.22. Why is it falling?
Compare with the sector benchmark and with Tenaris. Write 3 'so what' bullets.

p13.title: 1.3 Financial reports: do the numbers confirm the story?

steps.t: Read the EBITDA footnote (Presentation 2Q26 p.21): what does Borusan leave out? Say it in plain words.
Find one-off items in the notes: asset sales, provisions, FX gains. List each with its page.
Cash from operations vs net profit each year. If profit rises but cash does not, ask why.
Working capital: $247m (2Q25), $216m (2025), $168m (2Q26), Presentation p.22. Is cash being released, and will it last?
Accounting notes: reporting currency and inflation accounting. Which years can we compare fairly?
Write our clean EBITDA for each year, with every adjustment explained.

p14.title: 1.4 Quality of earnings: is the profit real?

Agree names and roles (Team, Edit names and roles)

t01.title: Team Zoom: agree roles and walk through the Map

steps.t: Risk-free rate: US 10-year Treasury yield with its date. Why US? We value Borusan in dollars.
Mature market equity risk premium: Damodaran January update. Write why we use the implied premium (Session 4).
Türkiye country risk premium (Damodaran). Decide: weight by where plants are or where revenue comes from (Session 4, lambda).
Bottom-up beta: Damodaran Betas by Sector, Steel (unlevered). Relever with Borusan's market debt/equity (Session 5).
Debt: financial debt and cash from the latest balance sheet. Cost of debt: check against the credit rating (28 Aug 2026).
Market value: share price times shares outstanding, with the date.
Write every input, source and date in the assumption book.

t02.title: Discount rate inputs: risk-free rate, ERP, CRP, beta, debt

steps.t: Revenue and EBITDA 2021-2025 (Guidance page) in one sheet.
Past free cash flow to the firm: EBITDA minus tax, capex and change in working capital.
Discount rate v0 from the inputs task.
5-year forecast: tons times price per ton by business line. Use a mid-cycle margin, not the best or worst year.
Terminal value: growth not above the risk-free rate.
Firm value minus net debt ($144m, 2Q26), divided by shares: value per share.
Sensitivity: WACC times terminal growth. Which input moves value most?

t03.title: Build my mini-DCF v0 in Excel (learning model)

steps.t: Get the annual financial reports 2021-2025 (Docs, IR site). Note each report's currency.
Income statement in USD: revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, EBITDA, net income. One column per year.
Balance sheet in USD: cash, receivables, inventory, fixed assets, debt, equity.
Cash flow in USD: cash from operations, capex, dividends.
Ratios: EBITDA margin, ROIC, net debt/EBITDA, working capital. Mark the best and worst years.
Check: does 2025 revenue match the Guidance page ($1.8bn)? If not, find out why.

t04.title: 5 years of financial statements in USD + key ratios

steps.t: Choose peers like an analyst: same pipes (welded line pipe, OCTG), US exposure, listed so data is public. Check: Tenaris, Vallourec, Welspun Corp, Jindal SAW, Cenergy.
Peer table: country, product, revenue, EBITDA margin, % North America, source and date. Template: Tenaris 2025, margin 24.2%, North America ~49% of tubes sales (results, 18 Feb 2026).
Explain the gap: why does Tenaris earn ~24% and Borusan 7.4%? Check product (seamless vs welded), own steel, services, scale.
Demand chain diagram: steel coil, Borusan, customers, and what drives their spending (Annual Report p.35-40, Presentation p.9).
Tariff timeline: date, measure, who it hits, effect on Borusan. Start with Section 232 and antidumping cases on usitc.gov.
Test the idea: US-made pipe is protected, pipe shipped from Türkiye is exposed (Annual Report p.45).

t05.title: Peer list, demand chain and tariff news

steps.t: Four business lines, one plain sentence each (Annual Report p.35-40).
Who buys each product and why. OCTG = pipes inside oil and gas wells. Line pipe = pipes that carry oil, gas and water.
Plants and capacity: US 950k tons, Türkiye 1.05m tons (Presentation p.5). Which plant serves which line?
US share of revenue and how it grew: 26% in 2014 to 79% in 1H26 (Presentation p.13).
Our three-sentence story. Test: could a 12-year-old understand it?
TSRS Report 2025 p.29-35: list the climate risks the company itself names.
CBAM in plain words: what it is, when it applies, who pays (TSRS p.7 terms, p.33-35).
Why does Borusan call EU exports its most significant transition risk? (TSRS p.35)
Emissions trend over the years (Sustainability Report 2024).
Analyst filter: keep only ESG items that change cash flows or the discount rate. Write how.
List 10 risks
Probability and impact for each
Top 3: what does each do to value?
